aiva_evidence.PVS1: Canonical splice donor (c.1551+1G>C, splice_donor_variant, ENST00000302262) per annotate_variant VEP. Literature (PMID:24399864) reports exon 10 skipping, p.Val480_Ile517del, an in-frame loss of an entire exon with active-site residues (W481, W516), which the GN010 VCEP lists as Very Strong for exons 8 and 10. Loss of function is the established Pompe mechanism. gnomAD GAA constraint is LOF-tolerant (pLI 1.7e-25), but the VCEP rule rests on exon-level active-site evidence, not gene constraint. Met at Very Strong per GN010 v2.0.
